title: Black Velvet Anarkali Kurta with Gold Brocade Palazzo & Potli Buttons
color_custom: Jet black velvet with antique gold brocade
description:
Rich, warm and timeless – a jet-black velvet Anarkali kurta paired with gold brocade palazzo pants. A gold brocade band collar, a long row of brocade-covered potli buttons and brocade cuffs give it a regal, old-Jaipur feel, while the panelled A-line skirt flares softly as you walk. Made for winter weddings, Diwali and Christmas parties, festive dinners and evening events.

✦ The Details
• Black velvet Anarkali / A-line kurta with full flare
• Gold brocade mandarin (band) collar
• Full front row of brocade-covered potli buttons
• Full sleeves with gold brocade cuffs
• Back keyhole opening with a pearl button
• Panelled bodice that shapes the waist
• Calf-length kurta
• Black and gold brocade palazzo pants with an elasticated waist

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft, heavy velvet with a deep natural sheen, lined for comfort so it sits smoothly and feels warm in cold weather. The collar, cuffs and buttons are cut from woven gold brocade with a paisley pattern. Stitched in our own Jaipur unit.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with a full, flowing skirt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Oxidised silver jhumkas and clear block heels for a festive dinner. Gold jhumkas, a potli bag and a bold red lip for a winter wedding. Add a gold or black organza dupatta, or a pashmina shawl, on cold evenings.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Velvet has a natural sheen that changes with light, so the colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Dry clean only. Store on a padded hanger or folded with tissue – do not press velvet flat. Steam lightly from the inside if needed.
